label: path-add-remove-include-exclude
notes: Classic include/exclude backtracking that adds the current element, recurses, undoes it, then explores the skip branch.

label: copy-on-include-exclude
notes: Uses copied path lists for the take and skip branches, so no explicit undo step is needed.

label: bitmask-enumeration
notes: Produces all subsequences, but uses iterative bitmask enumeration instead of recursion.

label: missing-skip-branch
notes: Only explores the include branch, so half of the subsequences are missing.

label: tiny-array-cheat
notes: Hardcodes outputs for a couple of visible input sizes instead of building all subsequences recursively.
